recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, cinematic portrait of a male figure in 1970s rock attire, leaning against a wall under a warm overhead light source, featuring expressive hand-drawn script typography in the upper corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm overhead glow contrasting with cool blue-grey shadows
Diagonal arm placement creating a frame around the central figure
Textural contrast between soft hair and sharp pinstripe fabric
Symmetrical placement of script text balancing the upper composition
coreInvariants: Low-angle warm light source at the top center
Central subject with direct eye contact

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, figure occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the warm light pool at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the overhead light, moves down to the face, follows the arms outward to the text in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space in the upper corners utilized for typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber/yellow (light source and skin highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the light source and deep shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected cursive with long flourishes
Informal, handwritten quality with varying baseline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended descenders and ascenders that loop into decorative swirls
Integrated star or symbol motifs within the lettering

composition.position: Upper left and upper right corners
composition.scale: Large enough to balance the head

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used for both artist name and title to maintain stylistic unity.
graphicDevices: Small star icon integrated into the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the era's aesthetic of informal but stylish lettering.
Captures the consistent stroke width of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s film-style portrait of a man with long dark hair, wearing a pinstripe vest over a light pink shirt and black tie. He is leaning against a blue-grey wall. A single warm yellow light source is positioned at the top center, casting a pool of light and creating moody shadows. The image should have a slight film grain and desaturated color palette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom hand-drawn monolinear script in a cream color to the upper left and upper right corners. The text should have an upward diagonal slant and include decorative flourishes that connect letters.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting source clearly visible at the top?
Does the script have a consistent monolinear weight?
Is the color palette dominated by cool blues and warm ambers?
Is the subject's pose relaxed yet framed by the composition?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the overhead light glow
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the script style.
Check that the light source doesn't blow out the details of the face.
Verify the pinstripe texture is visible but not distracting.
Confirm the grain feels like film, not digital noise.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a moody, low-key portrait with a warm top-down spotlight and balance the composition with diagonal, hand-lettered script in the upper negative spaces.
